intuition: Choose candidates in a fixed order and recurse on the remaining target; reuse is allowed by staying at the same index.

brute_force.approach: Enumerate candidate multisets and retain those summing to target.

optimal.approach: Backtrack with a start index, pruning candidates larger than the remaining target.

edge_cases: A candidate equal to the remainder completes a result.
Sort candidates so a too-large value ends the loop.
